method: Primary inspected each of five distinct extracted frames at full resolution. Seven requested times map to five recorded images.

frames.inspection: Before the audit, Conclusion and Actions use normal text size. Refresh and Sign out are visible.
Text is smaller during the audit interval. Copy controls and other text remain visually readable.
Text has enlarged. Row heights and scroll position change.
Text is very large. The viewport shows release metadata. Copy controls stack below values.
Text returns to its initial size. The Conclusion card is lower than before the audit. Sign out is now partly outside the viewport.

observation: The recorded full-audit interval contains text-size changes and returns to a different scroll position.
limits: Only the selected frames were inspected. This is not a claim that the whole video was watched.
Use actualSeconds, not requestedSeconds, for presentation times. The recording has intervals with no new video frame.
The recording does not identify the private native audit sample times. It does not establish the contrast or inaccessible-text cause.
No app correction or native-audit exception is justified by this observation alone.
